protocol.experiment_status: Exploratory second-reservoir pilot; not a reproduction of the published Gardiner calibration and not an independent diverse-cohort validation.
protocol.date_interpretation: Our explicit working split: leap-year 1980 warmup, 1981-1995 calibration and 1996-2011 validation. The 15/16-year split is not claimed as the paper's exact Gardiner protocol.
protocol.estimation_policy: Estimate monthly targets and bounds from calibration observations only, excluding warmup and validation.
protocol.catalog_source: GRanD_Dams_v1_1_DZTR.xlsx row GRAND_ID=253: SMAX=9870000000 agrees with CAP_MCM=9870; Q_DS_MAX=2500 and INFLOW_CORR=1.0. These are existing Gardiner catalog values, not independently verified physical metadata.
protocol.catalog_source_limitations: The catalog DATA_INFO and URL fields are blank; individual physical constants lack per-value source citations.
protocol.initial_state_policy: Initialize from normalized storage and release observed on the first warmup day, 1980-01-01. Storage(mil_m3) is multiplied by 1000000. The observation is excluded from calibration and validation scores.
protocol.catalog_initial_state_not_used: Catalog SINIT=6733399841 and QINIT=171 differ from the first source observations; their intended date is undocumented.
protocol.generic_model_assumptions: Dead-storage fraction 0.1, storage-driven flood mode, implicit solver and conservative overflow are explicit exploratory choices, not Gardiner-specific verified operating rules.
protocol.optimization_policy: Checkpointed seeded NSGA-II; illustrative stopping diagnostics use calibration costs only. Validation is reported after representative selection.
